AcceptedResponse.description:
Returned by register, resend-verification and forgot-password whatever the email,
so the response never reveals whether an account exists.
AcceptedResponse.title: AcceptedResponse

ErrorResponse.description: Documented in OpenAPI so generated clients know the error shape.
ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse

starts_at_local.description: Start in the event's own time zone, without an offset, e.g. for form inputs.
starts_at_local.title: Starts At Local

EventStatus.description:
Stored lifecycle, driven by the SRS 4.2 verbs (publish / unpublish / cancel).

SRS 4.16's dashboard classification (Upcoming / Active / Completed / Cancelled) is
*derived* from this plus the event's start and end times — it is not stored, because
'Upcoming' becomes 'Active' with the passage of time and no row is written.
EventStatus.title: EventStatus

EventUpdate.description:
Every field optional. Times without an offset use the event's (possibly new) zone;
the service resolves them, because the current zone lives in the database.
EventUpdate.title: EventUpdate

OrderCreate.description: Only ids and quantities. Every price and total is computed on the server (SRS 7).
OrderCreate.title: OrderCreate

OrderStatus.description: SRS 4.6: failed or abandoned transactions must never yield a valid ticket.
OrderStatus.title: OrderStatus

PayoutAccountRead.description: A simulated payout account. Only the last four digits are ever stored (SRS 7).
PayoutAccountRead.title: PayoutAccountRead

PayoutAccountStatus.description: SRS 3.2 step 4. Production KYC/KYB is explicitly excluded from the MVP (SRS 8).
PayoutAccountStatus.title: PayoutAccountStatus

RefreshRequest.description: The scanner app sends its refresh token in the body; the web app uses the cookie.
RefreshRequest.title: RefreshRequest

SeatingMode.description: SRS 4.3.1: general admission or assigned seating.
SeatingMode.title: SeatingMode

TicketStatus.description:
SRS 4.7 names exactly these four.

`CANCELLED` and `REFUNDED` are the two that drop a ticket out of the
`uq_ticket_active_seat` partial index, freeing the seat for resale.
TicketStatus.title: TicketStatus

TicketTypeRead.description:
The organizer's view, with the SRS 4.3 counts: available, reserved, sold, refunded,
checked in.
TicketTypeRead.title: TicketTypeRead

UserRole.description: SRS 2.3. `EVENT_ADMIN` is organizer-delegated and distinct from `PLATFORM_ADMIN`.
UserRole.title: UserRole

UserUpdate.description: Fields a user may change about themselves. Role and email are not among them.
UserUpdate.title: UserUpdate

post.description: Responds identically whether or not the email is registered.
Returns an access token. Browsers get the refresh token as an httpOnly cookie; clients sending `X-Client: scanner` get it in the body.

post.description: Send ticket type ids and quantities only; the server computes every price. A zero-total order (free registration) is confirmed at once and its tickets issued. A paid order is `awaiting_payment` and holds its tickets until `expires_at`. `409 sold_out` when there aren't enough tickets left.
post.summary: Reserve tickets and create an order
